title: Do Chinese Investors' Reactions to Merger Announcements Accurately Reflect Prospects for Success?
location: Cole Complex, third floor, West Virginia State University
abstract: Dr. Michael N. Young revisits a surprising finding in international business research: Chinese acquirers appeared to outperform U.S. counterparts in stock-market reactions to merger announcements. Invited in 2015 to write a commentary for Management and Organization Review, he questioned whether those short-term reactions could reliably indicate merger success. Using this experience, the seminar explores research-method assumptions, interpretation of statistically significant results, information economics and price discovery, and the challenges of applying research frameworks across economic and institutional contexts.
audience_note: Faculty, staff, and students across disciplines are welcome. No background in finance or economics is required; questions and alternative interpretations are encouraged.
refreshments_note: Pizza and refreshments will be provided.
